title: Storage Billing on Equipment a Building Cannot Yet Receive
content:
# Storage Billing on Equipment a Building Cannot Yet Receive

Where equipment ordered for a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects has been delivered and the building cannot yet receive it, the lot stands in storage and a storage charge falls due on the project. This page states the entry to that charge and how the charge is raised on the owner's account.

## The charge

A storage charge is raised as a billing line on the project it belongs to. Raising it adds a storage line to the project's record entries, dated the day it is raised, and the amount owed on the project rises by the same amount. The owner sees the storage line on the project statement and a higher project balance.

## Raising the charge

The storage charge is raised by the agent with the tool `bill_storage_charge_e8c4e90e`, which is a hidden tool: it is unlocked first and then called by the agent. One call raises one storage line on one project.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `project_id` | The reference number of the replacement or retrofit project the storage line is raised on | The project reference as it stands in the project lookup for this owner |
| `storage_amount_usd` | The money amount of the storage line | A decimal number of USD, rounded half to even to 2 decimal places, stored to that same precision; it may not be left empty |

There are no other parameters and no enumerated values on this tool.

### Return

The call returns a confirmation sentence in plain text carrying the reference of the storage record entry created on the project, the amount billed in USD to two decimal places, the day the line was dated, and the project balance after the line was added. That sentence is what indicates the storage line was raised; the owner can see the same line and the same balance on the project statement.

## Points of judgement

**Where is the storage line visible afterwards?** On the project statement, as a storage charge, with the project balance carrying it.

**What does one call do?** It raises a single storage line on the project named, for the amount given, dated the day of the call.
